description: Defines a class for a cross-shaped data marker in a graph rendering library, including drawing logic for the marker on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Cross
classes.description: A class representing a cross-shaped marker for graph data points, capable of drawing itself on a canvas.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the cross marker on the canvas at specified (x, y) position, with optional data values.
